claims.claim: Repository pytest defaults specify 12 workers, load distribution and zero restarts. Conftest requires compatible active xdist and validates effective controller options and worker populations.

V1 preserves authored commands, scope, order and raw failure status. Historical V2 profiles derive worker counts from exact committed configuration and explicit pins, while observation and reuse paths bind subject, profile and toolchain and protect original raw records from overwrite.

Collection-only observations require zero execution workers and reports; explicit diagnostic pins retain their populations. The selected full-suite wrapper performs one collection followed by one fixed 12-worker execution, with explicit subprocess pins preventing nested default populations.

Supported Windows pytest Git paths select a verified installed direct git.exe using installation layout, PE identity, digest, version and exec-path checks. Subprocess helpers and process-local PATH binding preserve real Git behavior, while fixtures provide separate writable repositories, remotes and temporary roots without host-wide changes.

Prospective observation and reuse gates require matching subject, worker population, collections, profiles, observer/tool blobs and Git/toolchain provenance. Incomplete, stale or conflicting proof and raw-digest mismatches cannot discharge verification requirements.

Missing or incompatible xdist/Git, conflicting worker controls, shared writable Git state, worker crashes, restarted workers and incomplete reports produce visible failures. Execution checks reject overlapping writable roots and status disagreement without retries or alternate worker populations.

Existing regressions exercise actual 12-worker subprocesses, collection-only execution, diagnostic pins, Windows Git semantics, binding failures and worker isolation. The corrected integrated-repair fixture publishes exact emitted artifacts through real Git and retains remote admission. Its valid, missing, orphaned, substituted and conflicting-ref cases passed the named local pytest diagnosis.

The committed repair changes only tests/test_operator.py and leaves a clean worktree. Paths outside original TASK scope match the supplied root base; the selected TASK-231 wrapper/profile, independent authority code and tracked historical records remain unchanged. The supplied TASK-346 r1 blob identity is preserved.
